title: An author override on one draft does not inherit to a later draft's fresh loss.
purpose: An override records reason/artifact/clauses and cancels its human-required task, but does not mutate the report and does not inherit to later DraftAttempts; a re-drafted scene that loses the same clause again materializes a NEW (successor) Issue (ADR 0009/0020/0024).

clauses.statement: The reconciliation is earned on-page, not asserted in narration.

satisfaction_criterion.statement: A dramatized beat shows the shift in trust before it is named.
